description: LiveAvatar audio-driven avatar video generation using the Wan2.2 S2V architecture.

request.name: reference_image_path
request.description: Reference image path used as the identity/appearance condition.

request.name: generation_mode
request.description: Use whole-clip generation or LiveAvatar blockwise generation.

request.name: height
request.description: Generated frame height.

request.name: width
request.description: Generated frame width.

request.name: num_frames
request.description: Frames generated per LiveAvatar segment.

request.name: num_clips
request.description: Maximum LiveAvatar clips to generate from the input audio.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Euler denoising steps; the LiveAvatar DMD adapter is designed for 4 steps.

request.name: guidance_scale
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale; LiveAvatar blockwise generation requires 0.

request.name: fused_cfg
request.description: Run classifier-free guidance in one denoiser graph.

request.name: sage_attention
request.description: Use CUDA SageAttention when the backend supports it.

request.name: memory_saver
request.description: Reuse immutable condition data and temporary denoiser graph storage across sequential blocks.

request.name: denoiser_layerwise
request.description: Run the denoiser in layerwise mode.

request.name: denoiser_layerwise_batch
request.description: Layer group size used by layerwise denoising.

request.name: vae_encoder_chunk_size
request.description: Cached VAE encoder chunk size.

request.name: vae_decoder_tile_size
request.description: VAE decoder spatial tile size; 0 disables tiling.

request.name: target_cache_blocks
request.description: Target KV cache window in block units; 0 keeps the full clip cache.

request.name: vae_cache_f16
request.description: Store cached VAE encoder state in F16.

request.name: shift
request.description: Euler flow scheduler shift.

request.name: negative_prompt
request.description: Negative prompt for classifier-free guidance.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed.

session.name: denoiser_weight_streaming
session.description: Keep denoiser transformer blocks in host memory and stage layer groups on the accelerator.

session.name: support_gguf
session.description: Support GGUF containing text_encoder/audio_encoder tensors and the embedded tokenizer sidecar.

session.name: vae_gguf
session.description: Wan video VAE component GGUF file relative to the model root.

session.name: denoiser_gguf
session.description: Denoiser DiT GGUF file relative to the model root.

load.name: support_gguf
load.description: Support GGUF containing text_encoder/audio_encoder tensors and the embedded tokenizer sidecar.

load.description: Wan video VAE component GGUF file relative to the model root.
